_comment: Ratchet baselines for scripts/verify.py. Lowering a number is routine (run --update-baseline after a cleanup). Raising one is a deliberate regression and must be justified in review.
_note: updated 2026-09-02: sidebar_links 25 -> 27 is a CORRECTED MEASUREMENT, not link growth — audit F-11 changed the admin-zone predicate from is_platform_admin (which the check's stub evaluated falsy, hiding the zone: platform_admin measured 16) to user.is_admin() (what @admin_required enforces); an Administrator platform_admin now renders 27, within SIDEBAR_LINK_BUDGET 28. No link definitions were added. shell_conformance 3 remains.
_note2: updated 2026-09-17: evidence_contract 29 -> 30 for merge 424162db (PR #20, fix/model-class-deduplication). The substantive commit (9cfe2af6) carries real same-commit test coverage (tests/test_fast_init_model_tenancy.py, tests/test_outcome_tenancy.py -- 33 passed, 0 failed, red-then-green demonstrated per commit body) but used a prose 'Regression:' line instead of the literal 'Evidence:' keyword the gate scans for, and the merge commit itself (424162db) carries no trailer of its own. Rewriting already-pushed main history to fix the wording was judged not worth a force-push; accepted as one unit of debt rather than silently ignored. Future commits on this bucket's pattern should use a literal 'Evidence:' trailer to avoid tripping this gate.

_note6: updated 2026-09-26: untenanted_reads 2990 -> 2988. _note8: updated 2026-09-26: untenanted_reads 2788 -> 2633. APQCProcess (97) and TechnicalCapability (58) are shared reference catalogues (rows created only by seed commands; the tenant link for APQC is SolutionAPQCProcess), now listed in GLOBAL_MODELS in scripts/check_untenanted_reads.py with the evidence. FeatureFlag and ElementTemplate were checked and deliberately left counted.
_note9: updated 2026-09-26: store_agreement 1 -> 4 is a measurement step, not a regression. The gate now asks every store and screen for work packages, gaps (split by gap_kind: every row / capability shortfall / plateau transition), risks, application owners, architecture decisions, three pending-proposal queues (AI change approvals, review queue items, relationship suggestions, each its own question), applications with a recorded annual cost, contracts and vendors, and its screens sign in through the session registry instead of answering 401. Surfaces answering a different question are not registered (live-computed capability-map gaps and RoadmapGap, ComplianceGap, TechnologyRoadmapInitiative, DecisionLedger). Measured on the demonstration organisation (flask seed-demo-company), four genuine disagreements, each attributed to the branch that closes it: capabilities (the existing one; feat/r1-one-capability-store), work packages (UnifiedWorkPackage 12 vs every list screen 0; feat/r1-one-work-package-store), application owners (ApplicationOwner 20 vs ApplicationOwnership 0 and owner text 0; feat/r1-one-owner-record) and applications with a recorded annual cost (application cost columns 20 vs ApplicationCost 0; feat/r1-one-application-cost). Gaps no longer disagree once each surface is compared with surfaces showing the same gap kinds. Each consolidation lowers this again. A fresh database with no organisation measures 0.
_note10: added 2026-09-28: tenant_isolation_route_coverage_pct 44.0 is the share of identifier-bearing routes (one rule, one method) proven to refuse another organisation's identifiers, measured by the route sweep in tests/test_tenant_isolation_matrix.py and enforced by that test, not by a verify.py gate. It is the one ratchet here where HIGHER is better: raise it after proving more routes, never lower it.

_note12: updated 2026-10-05: merged origin/main, which carries PR #353's Approval Inbox link and moves SIDEBAR_LINK_BUDGET 31 -> 32 (see app/utils/role_access.py's comment) — this branch's own _note11 cited the now-stale 31. The two links _note11 describes ("Model as of", "Changes") are the only ones behind the 30; only the budget figure needed correcting, to 32.
_note13: added 2026-10-01: platform_admin_coverage 463 is the true current count, not 0 -- same reasoning as untenanted_reads and unregistered_checks (baselining an existing hole at 0 would make this checker immediately fail on a codebase it has not changed). Seven real instances of this exact bug (admin_required where platform_admin_required was needed on a model with no tenant column at all: ExternalSystem, Job, AIPromptTemplate, ScoringConfiguration, FeatureFlag) were each caught only by a human/AI reviewer reading a diff across PRs 307, 312, 314 and 315 before this gate existed; the gate's first run against main also found one the review cycle had not: app/api/dashboard_routes.py's create/update/delete_scoring_configuration (a third, 'DEPRECATED... do not add new code here' copy of the scoring-configuration routes, gated only by @login_required -- any signed-in user, not even an org admin -- matching the pre-existing SECURITY-FINDINGS-R2-5.md F-1 entry), fixed in the same commit that adds the gate. The baseline is 466 (first run) minus 3 (that fix) = 463. The count can only go down from here.
_note14: updated 2026-10-01: platform_admin_coverage 463 -> 347 is a precision fix, not progress on the underlying bug (see _note13 for the original 463 baseline). The scanner was flagging any model REFERENCE inside a write route as a write of that model -- ADMPhase.query.get(id), read only to validate a foreign key before creating an unrelated KanbanCard, counted as 'writes ADMPhase'. Rewrote _ModelRefScan to require an actual mutation (a constructor, an attribute-assignment on a variable fetched from the model, a chained .update()/.delete(), or db.session.delete()) -- the fetch-then-mutate shape every real instance of this bug used, proven by tests/test_check_platform_admin_coverage.py's new false-positive regression test. IMPORTANT CAVEAT on what the remaining 347 means: spot-checking the three largest groups after the fix (CodegenGeneration 30, SolutionArchiMateElement 22, Deliverable 10) found all three are models with no tenant column but scoped via a foreign key to an ALREADY-FENCED PARENT (solution_id -> Solution, work_package_id -> WorkPackage) -- a genuinely different risk question (does the route verify the parent's ownership before writing) that platform_admin_required would answer WRONG for (it would block every ordinary tenant user from their own solution's data). This gate's real, narrow finding -- the admin_required/platform_admin_required mixup on genuinely parentless singleton config (ExternalSystem, Job, AIPromptTemplate, ScoringConfiguration, FeatureFlag) -- is close to fully closed out by PRs 307/312/314/315/321. Most of the remaining 347 need a separate, FK-aware ownership-fence audit, not more platform_admin_required fixes; left baselined here rather than attempting that larger, different project in this gate.
_note15: added 2026-10-01: named_platform_admin_coverage 10 (pr321-review-v1 nit 3 -- a stricter sub-gate counting only hits on NAMED_PLATFORM_MODELS, the five confirmed-real parentless singleton-config models (ExternalSystem, Job, AIPromptTemplate, ScoringConfiguration, FeatureFlag), not the broad scan's FK-scoped-parent noise). The 10 are all still-open PR #314 (Jira ExternalSystem/Job routes) plus two newly-found AIPromptTemplate routes in app/modules/ai_chat/routes/chat_admin_routes.py (persona-prompt overrides, a different feature from the solution-prompt overrides PR #307 already fixed) -- fixed in the same commit that adds this sub-gate, via an in-body _require_platform_admin() call rather than a decorator (marked platform-admin-ok since the broad scanner only recognises the decorator form). Should reach and hold at 0 once PR #314 merges.
_note16: added 2026-10-08, merge of PR #321 into main: the 3-way merge of this file left a duplicate 'platform_admin_coverage' key (347 from this branch's own history, 463 stray from main's side) that json.load silently resolved to the later one, 463 -- so verify.py was comparing today's real count against a four-notes-stale baseline without reporting it as a conflict. Removed the duplicate and re-measured: 308 on this merged tree (down from 347), a further precision/fix improvement since _note14, not re-verified in detail here. Lowering the ratchet to the measured value per this file's own _comment.
